parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that fits into the table frame, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: Provides storage space for small items such as stationery or documents.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden drawer similar to the first, part of the table’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: Used for organizing and storing small items.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden drawer located in the table’s front section.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel that supports the rear structure of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural stability and prevents drawers from sliding out the back.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel forming part of the table’s frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawers laterally.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another vertical wooden side panel on the opposite side of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden bottom panel located beneath the drawers.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawers and connects the side panels.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting one corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden leg supporting another corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wooden leg completing the table’s support system.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Divider Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden divider panel inside the drawer section.
parts.Functional_description: Separates drawers and provides internal structural support.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Divider Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another vertical divider panel parallel to the first one.
parts.Functional_description: Provides internal separation and stability for drawers.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The main flat wooden surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
